character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of an original Mega/Ultra-level cosmic anomaly entity inspired by Abaddomon Core, ominous floating stance, front/three-quarter view.

Visual Design:
- Core Sphere: Massive floating dark void sphere composed of swirling obsidian-black matter and crimson digital distortion glitches, featuring a giant central glowing blood-red demonic eye with a vertical golden slit pupil.
- Armor & Cyber Shell: Segmented white and gold Chrome Digizoid outer armor plates orbiting and partially enclosing the dark sphere like cracked planetary rings, pulsing with glowing purple circuit traces.
- Eldritch Appendages: Multiple writhing cyber-organic tentacles and segmented bladed cables made of gunmetal steel emerging from the core's shadows, tipped with red laser emitters and sharp talons.
- Minor Eyes & Hazard Markings: Several smaller glowing cyan sensor eyes scattered across the floating outer armor pieces, accompanied by glowing red digital hazard triangle runes.
- Aura & FX: Glitching digital particle mist, black void aura, and flickering red lightning sparks radiating around the entire entity.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas resolution.
- High-contrast eldritch glow effects, sharp dark pixel outlines, surreal cybernetic horror palette.
- Centered sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
